title: CHGR Governance Record Integrity
description: Artifact classification: Integrity metadata. Answers 'is the stored payload the same bytes now as when published' (CHGR-001 Sec.10). Digest validity never establishes authority (CHGR-REQ-093).

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 of the referencing HumanGovernanceRecord's own canonical payload at publication time (CHGR-REQ-071). Recomputed and compared at verification, never at this schema layer.

rendering_digest.description: SHA-256 of the deterministic human-readable rendering of the same payload, so a later regeneration can be checked byte-for-byte (CHGR-REQ-023).

digest_algorithm.description: Fixed for this increment; an open string (not an enum) would let a future revision add an algorithm without redefining this field.

extensions.description: Controlled additive extension container. Empty object permitted.
